# Anime2.5DRig runtime helper

Source: https://github.com/852wa/Anime2.5DRig
Revision: 7450341934a8ff77bf05b90d9f708786e3eb3996
File: lib/runtime.js, copied unchanged as runtime.cjs for module interop.
License: MIT, see LICENSE in this directory.

The companion uses the time-substepped spring integrator for neck-tilt response.
No upstream sample images, PSDs, generic facial art, or camera services are included.
This helper does not replace Cubism or export a Cubism model.
